description: In Mumbai, the Maharashtra School Education Department has signed a Letter of Intent with Google for Education to train over four lakh teachers in Artificial Intelligence and digital skills through the ‘Google AI Educator Series’. The 18-month programme aims to enhance AI literacy and modern teaching methods across government and aided schools without financial burden on the state.
body_lead: Mumbai: In a major step towards integrating emerging technologies into the education sector, the Maharashtra School Education Department on Friday signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) with Google for Education to provide advanced training in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital technology to teachers across the state. Programme Scale Under the initiative, more than four lakh teachers from government and aided schools will receive training through the ‘Google AI Educator Series’ over the next 18 months.
